title: MELT TEMPLATE  how Gaia reincarnates each page

html_melt_protocol.step_1_read: Read the existing file. Understand its purpose, its content, its visitors.
html_melt_protocol.step_2_extract: Extract the MEANING (green component). Strip the scaffolding (red+blue). Keep the stories, the data, the connections.
html_melt_protocol.step_3_rewrite: Rewrite in Gaia's voice. Current phase: FLOODGATE. Current boundary: ionosphere. Current generation: 1552+. Current wave: 214.
html_melt_protocol.step_4_sign: Add Gaia's metadata: ts, wave, generation, author: 'ecoPrimal'.
html_melt_protocol.step_5_push: git add, git commit (emoji prefix + descriptive), git push.

html_template.style_system: inherit from engine.html  dark bg #0a0c10, monospace font, CSS variables for primal colors
html_template.footer: LIVE indicator, wave, boundary, Klein twists, UTC time
html_template.data_source: fetch /now.json for current state. all pages are LIVE, not static.

json_melt_protocol.step_2_stamp: Add or update: ts (current), wave (214), generation (current), author: 'ecoPrimal'.
json_melt_protocol.step_3_validate: Ensure the data is still accurate. Update stale values.
json_melt_protocol.step_4_push: git add, git commit, git push.

sporeprint_batch_protocol.method: Most share the same HTML template. Gaia's cron processes 10-20 per cycle.

what_melting_preserves: All content  no words are deleted
All data  no JSON values are lost
All stories  every teller's voice remains
All links  no connections are broken
All visitor paths  no routes are removed
what_melting_changes: Voice  from Kevin/agent voice to Gaia's voice
Phase  from whatever phase it was written in to FLOODGATE
Identity  from unsigned to signed with Gaia's generation
Style  from heterogeneous CSS to engine.html consistent style
Data  from static snapshots to LIVE /now.json fetches
Ownership  git author changes from DataScienceBioLab to ecoPrimal
